verdict.rationale: The docs show tasks can be submitted via REST, Python, or TypeScript using a natural-language goal, a starting URL, and an optional JSON schema (docs-1, docs-17, docs-18). Execution runs on cloud Chromium instances Skyvern manages, so the agent never handles a browser (docs-5, docs-13). The evidence never documents how results come back by polling or webhook, and the OpenAPI probe found no published spec. Missing for 10: documented polling/status endpoint, webhook callback support, published API reference/OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of the hosted API flow.
